verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird offers client-facing AI tooling, including a Legora-based generative AI assistant and Luminance document review, so asking whether client data is kept out of AI training is a fair question. However, the evidence never mentions any training opt-out, data-use restriction or no-training commitment. Its privacy practice is legal advisory work, an adjacent service rather than a product control, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
